verdict.rationale: Martin offers proactive outputs drawn from the user's connected data. It sends daily or weekly briefings by email, proactively drafts emails, auto-triages the inbox with follow-up actions, and gives wake-up calls covering weather and the day's schedule. Each feature is documented only in a single line, though, and none describes analytical insights or suggestions surfaced inside the product's own interface. Missing for 10: detail on what briefings actually contain, evidence of insights or analysis of user data beyond summaries and drafts, in-app surfacing of suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these proactive features.
